title: Runbo Li improved return on ArviFoxy's fourth-power face
description: Proves the all-moduli Dirichlet boundary 4373037/5000000 = 0.8746074, with the principal pole excluded. The construction preserves ArviFoxy's repeated-mark source chain on Sil's fourth-power source face and replaces only the final return certificate. The exact rational return cover uses 50 Bernstein rows and 24 admission windows at h = 4009/5000, count cap 13/250, numerator cap 9/200, and natural cost K = 9/2. The six conductor edges have positive return and admission certificates; the new-top minimum return coefficient is positive. This is a one-unit-in-the-last-decimal improvement over 0.8746075. ArviFoxy and Sil are credited for the inherited source graph and fourth-power face; Hailey Collet and OpenAI are credited through the retained dependencies and notices.
